Two new S7CommPlus features: the PLC can send the changes of your tags (no polling), and a new
node for PLC alarms. Also a fix for writes of Bools in optimized DBs. **Upgrade if you use
S7CommPlus (S7-1200/1500)**, in particular if you write Bools of optimized DBs.

## Highlights

- **`s7 watch` with a PLC subscription.** New mode "PLC subscription" (S7CommPlus): the node
  subscribes to the tags, the PLC checks them every interval and sends only the values that
  changed. There is no read request per cycle, and `msg.ts` is the PLC time of the change. After a
  reconnect the node subscribes again; if the PLC refuses the subscription, the node reads
  cyclically as before. The default mode does not change.
- **New node `s7 alarms`.** One message per PLC alarm event (Program_Alarm and the other alarms of
  the CPU): `msg.state` is `coming` or `going`, `msg.payload` has the times, the associated values,
  the priority, the class and the texts. At start, and again after a reconnect, it sends the active
  alarms. The node status shows how many alarms are active. Example flow "05 - S7CommPlus alarms".
- **Bools of optimized DBs can be written.** Before this release, `s7 write` refused every Bool in
  an optimized S7-1500 DB with "writing BBool is not supported" (reads worked). Risk: none for other
  values; the write failed with an error, it did not reach another address.

All three were tested on PLCSIM Advanced V8 (S7-1500, FW S4.1, TLS): the S7-1500 FW V4.x sends no
changes for a subscription without a cycle time, and no alarms for the TIA Portal subscription
layout. The nodes handle both.

## Upgrade notes

- None. The new mode and the new node are opt-in; existing flows work as before.
- `s7 info` action `alarms` returns more fields (`state`, `priority`, `alarmClass`, associated
  values); the old fields are the same.
